chassis.note: Product page and manual Appendix B agree: 1.7 x 17.2 x 25.6 in, 43 x 437 x 650 mm on the page, 1U, chassis CSE-815BTS-R000WNP. 437 is the body between the ear folds on both photographs. No document says what the depth runs between.

controls.note: Manual figure 1-2 and its tables; see supermicro/control-panel-sc815b@1.

drive-numbering.note: Manual figure 1-1 and its Storage Drive Numbers table: 0 to 3, left to right. Nothing is printed on the metal beside the bays that the photograph resolves, and it does resolve the control panel's 1.4 mm digits, so no bay numerals are drawn.

ears.note: THE EARS ARE NOT DRAWN. On the front photograph each ear with its handle runs about 75 px outside the fold, 19 mm. The control panel is on the body.

environmental.note: Product page: operating 10 to 35 C, non-operating -30 to 60 C, operating relative humidity 8 to 80% non-condensing, non-operating 8 to 90%.

faces.note: Bottom, left and right are sized from the stated dimensions and declared empty: no document held shows any of them straight on.

front.note: Four hot-swap 3.5 inch bays in a row, starting at 5.6 on a 108.6 pitch, 16.9 down, each seating a 104.0 x 24.2 tray. Above them a strip 2.9..16 down: at the left a dark panel that holds the service tag and the optional slim DVD bay; then a run of rectangular vent windows, broken where the maker's badge is fixed (189..221, not drawn); and at the right the control panel, 368.8..433.3.

gate-1-front.note: The front photograph passes the panel gate: the front photograph of the SYS-511E-WR embedded on page 10 of its manual (1959 x 593 at 300 ppi), on which the body between the ear folds is 1745 px for 437 mm, 3.993 px/mm, and the face 171.5 px for 43 mm, 3.988 px/mm, 0.1% apart. It is taken from slightly above, so the lid shows over the face, but the face itself is square to the lens. The four trays are the check: they start at 141.5, 576.5, 1009 and 1441.5 px, steps of 435, 432.5 and 432.5, an even 433.3 px, 108.5 mm.

gate-1-rear.note: Measured off the rear photograph on page 13 of the same manual (1959 x 531), body 1745 px across, 3.993 px/mm, the same scale as the front. Everything on the I/O plate and the slot wall lands where the SYS-111E-WR has it, to 3.5 mm at the worst and usually to 1: the serial port at 144.8 against 148.2, the BMC port 174.8 / 173.6, LAN1 209.9 / 210.1, VGA 256.7 / 256.2, the thumbscrew post 306.8 / 309.2. The rear is therefore drawn at the SYS-111E-WR's figures, which were read off a squarer image; the two supplies alone are this chassis's own, their faces at 4.8..57.9 and 61.2..115.0.

gold-series.note: The product page lists a second SKU, "SYS-511E-WR-01-G2 Gold Series version with pre-configured components". The page does not say which components, and no document held does; it is entered as an orderable configuration of the same hardware with nothing seated differently.

interior.note: THE TOP VIEW IS THE CHASSIS UNDER ITS TOP COVER, rear at the top; the cover (supermicro/system-cover-sc815b@1) is seated and comes off in the viewer. The interior is read off the top-down photograph of the open chassis on page 15 of the same manual (1044 x 1516 at 300 ppi; front at the top as printed, turned here so the rear is), on which the chassis is 867 px across for 437 mm (1.984 px/mm) and 1298 px front to rear for 650 (1.997), 0.7% apart, so it passes the panel gate. The board lies 115.1..318.1 across, the SYS-111E-WR's 115.0..318.0, and is that server's board part; on this image the DIMMs centre 254.8 from the rear where the board part puts them 256.6. FIVE FANS AND ONE EMPTY HOUSING stand 373 from the rear: one fan at 39.8, the empty housing next to it, and four fans from 130.9 on a 43.4 pitch - the manual says five fans "plus one additional fan housing space", and the photograph shows which. The backplane is at 469 and the fixed drive cage cover runs from 491.7 to the front. The supplies, the risers and any cards are not placed in this view: each projects from its rear bay through that bay's `plan:`. WHAT IS NOT READ OFF THIS IMAGE: the air shroud and the two riser outlines are the SYS-111E-WR's parts, estimated there, and this server is photographed with its shroud out.

lifecycle.note: Searched 2026-10-05 for an end-of-life notice. SUPERMICRO HAS PUBLISHED NONE THAT WAS FOUND: its product page and its own store page still offer the system and carry no end-of-sale wording. RESELLERS SAY OTHERWISE and are not the vendor: one lists the SYS-511E-WR as discontinued (allstarshop.com) and a search summary of another says it is approaching end of sale with the AS-1115SV-WTNRT named as the alternative. Those are recorded here and not written as an announcement.

power.note: NO MAXIMUM SYSTEM POWER IS STATED on the product page, the datasheet, the manual or the quick reference guide. The Lot 9 addendum gives the idle state power at the higher boundary temperature of the operating class, 253.58 W, for its tested configuration - an idle figure under one regulation's test, not a maximum.

psus.note: Product page and manual Appendix B: two PWS-861A-1R, 860 W, redundant 1+1, Titanium. Both are seated by default.

slots.note: Product page: 2 PCIe 5.0 x16 FHFL slots and 1 PCIe 5.0 x8 (in x16) LP slot, as the SYS-111E-WR. The slots are bays of the two riser parts that server seats (supermicro/riser-wio-lhs-x13sew@1, supermicro/riser-wio-rhs-x13sew@2).

sources.note: Read for this model: Supermicro's product page for the SYS-511E-WR (supermicro.com/en/products/system/wio/1u/sys-511e-wr) and its two-page datasheet, for dimensions, weight, ports, slots, power supply and environmentals; the User's Manual MNL-2491, for the front, control panel, rear and top figures, the drive numbering, LED tables and Appendix B; the quick reference guide QRG-2491; the Lot 9 addendum; and the X13SEW motherboard manual MNL-2413. Three photographs embedded in the manual at 300 ppi are measured: the front on page 10 (1959 x 593), the rear on page 13 (1959 x 531) and the open chassis from above on page 15 (1044 x 1516). No vendor 3D model is on the product page and NetBox's devicetype-library has no entry. THE REAR, THE BOARD AND THE RISERS ARE THE SYS-111E-WR's: the same X13SEW-F board behind the same I/O plate, the same PWS-861A-1R supplies and the same three slots, and this device's rear view is generated from that one. The SC815 chassis manual held covers the older SC815 chassis and was not used for geometry.

weight.note: Product page: net weight 21.5 lbs (9.75 kg), gross 34.5 lbs (15.46 kg), for the barebone.
